project_info.tagline: Exclusive Everyday Deals & Local Discounts Across Australia
project_info.target_audience: Everyday Australian consumers, families, foodies, cafe enthusiasts, and parents seeking local savings

design_archetype.name: Organic Fresh & Tactile Utility (Archetype 1 + Swiss Clarity)
design_archetype.description: Clean, highly approachable, and warm light theme anchored by Deep Teal (#17434C), vibrant Coral (#B9512E) conversion accents, and refreshing Mint (#EAF6F3) surfaces. Replaces generic SaaS gradients with tactile card borders, generous whitespace, high-contrast crisp text, and micro-interactions.
design_archetype.theme_mode: Light (with optional subtle dark surfaces for partner/admin dashboard context)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#17434C]
hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-[#475569] leading-relaxed max-w-2xl

contrast_rules.text_on_mint: Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 using #17434C or #0F3138 text
contrast_rules.badge_contrast: High contrast dark teal text on mint/sage pills or coral text on soft coral pills

header_nav.styles: bg-[#EAF6F3]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#D3ECE7] z-50 sticky top-0 px-4 lg:px-8 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Nav links: Home, Explore Deals, How It Works, Pricing (A$49/yr), Partner With Us
Action CTAs: Sign In button, Get Go Perks (Coral pill CTA)
Mobile viewport: Hamburger trigger + responsive drawer + bottom navigation tab bar for logged in members

hero_section.layout: 2-column dynamic hero (Left text + live stats + quick search bar; Right interactive deal preview card stack or live member digital card)
hero_section.cta: Join for A$49/Year -> Unlock Deals Immediately

deal_card.styles: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D3ECE7] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col group
deal_card.offer_tag: absolute top-3 left-3 bg-[#B9512E] text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm
deal_card.favourite_button: absolute top-3 right-3 p-2 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-full text-[#17434C] hover:text-[#B9512E]
deal_card.ratings_row: flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#17434C] mb-2
deal_card.member_favourite_badge: bg-[#E8F2EA] text-[#4E7A58] border border-[#4E7A58]/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold

deals_rows.new_this_week: Horizontal scrolling row with 'NEW THIS WEEK' accent header tag
deals_rows.ending_soon: Horizontal scrolling row with timer indicator and 'ENDING SOON' alert pill

live_member_card.description: Virtual membership pass rendered in the member dashboard and deal redemption view
live_member_card.styles: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#17434C] via-[#0F3138] to-[#1E525C] text-white p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden border border-white/10
features: Dynamic live clock timestamp strip (seconds ticking)
Rotating unique security QR code / barcode simulation for venue scanning
Member name, active status badge (ACTIVE MEMBER), expiry date, member ID format #GP-2026-XXXX
One-click 'Show In-Store Screen' high-visibility popover view

member_reviews_module.average_score_display: Large star rating breakdown (e.g. 4.8 / 5.0 based on verified member redemptions)
member_reviews_module.review_card: Verified Member avatar, name, suburb, rating stars, date, and short testimonial quote
member_reviews_module.review_form: Modal or inline card allowing logged-in members to pick 1-5 stars, add short experience text, and submit with instant optimistic state update

mobile_bottom_tab_bar.description: Sticky bottom bar visible on mobile screen widths (< 768px) for active members

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rules: All interactive components (buttons, deal cards, category tiles, review forms, search inputs, tab triggers) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the light theme tokens (#EAF6F3 bg, #17434C text/primary, #B9512E action CTA) across public and member-facing pages.
Embed the Go Perks logos provided in /brand/go-perks-logo-horizontal.png and /brand/go-perks-mark.png in navigation and hero.
Implement the 3 requested new features: Category Tiles bento grid, 'New this week' / 'Ending soon' deal carousels, and Member reviews/ratings system.
Ensure all deal cards display distance chips, open badges, and 1-5 star member ratings.
Keep mobile views ultra-responsive with a clean bottom tab bar for active members.
